cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Předmět prohlubuje resp. poskytuje studentům nové znalosti v oblasti speciální aplikace chemie a biochemie pro chemickou stavbu dřeva a biosyntézu hlavních stavebních složek dřeva. Zahrnuje chemické změny dřeva způsobené chemickými, fyzikálními a biologickými vlivy. Vysvětluje souvislosti mezi složením dřeva a možnostmi jeho zpracování.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The subject provides new knowledge in the field of special application of chemistry and biochemistry for chemical composition of wood and biosynthesis of main wood components. It includes chemical changes of wood caused by chemical, physical and biological effects. It explains the connection between the composition of wood and the possibilities of its processing.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to wood chemistry (allowance 2/0) a.Chemistry of macromolecular substances.2.Natural substances (allowance 6/0) a.Carbohydrates.b.Proteins.c.Phenolics, terpenes, alkaloids.3.Chemical structure of wood and bark (allowance 4/0) a.Cellulose, hemicelluloses.b.Lignin.c.Extractives.4.Formation of woody matter: photosynthesis, biosynthesis of polysaccharides and lignin (allowance 4/0)5.Wall structure of wood cells (allowance 2/0) a.Wall structure.b.Distribution of substances in the wall.c.Water in wood.6.Natural decomposition of wood (allowance 2/0)7.Reactions of wood in acidic and alkaline environments (allowance 2/0)8.Biochemical principles of biological attack (allowance 2/0)9.Degradation of wood by physical influences (allowance 2/0)10.Application of wood mass (allowance 2/0)11.Practical laboratory exercises (allowance 0/28) a.Isolation of the main components of wood.b.Hydrolysis of poly- and oligosaccharides.c.Spectrophotometric determination of wood substances.d.Volumetric analysis of wood substances.e.Qualitative analysis of wood substances.f.Use of chromatography (TLC) in the analysis of wood substances.g.Enzymatic determination.
